_comment: List every channel here. 'key' must match the CHANNEL{n} secret naming (channel1 -> CHANNEL1_YT_TOKEN). 'label' is a short human name for the Telegram message. 'gmail_hint' pre-fills the Google login screen with that email. 'youtube_channel_name' is the exact name shown on YouTube's channel-picker screen (needed when one Gmail has more than one channel). 'client_id' is OPTIONAL per-channel override for channels on their own Google Cloud project; if omitted, 'default_client_id' below is used. client_id is NOT sensitive -- it's fine here. The matching client_secret values live ONLY in Vercel's CLIENT_SECRETS_JSON env var, never in this repo.
